summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long META Daily ETF (METG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Meta Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ: META) stock, less fees and expenses METG was launched on Jul 2, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
